action_instruction: Checking whether the reloaded todo items are visible in the todo list
intent: whether the tasks visible before the reload are still visible in the todo list after the reload

action_params.condition: Each task visible immediately before the page reload remains visible immediately after the reload.
action_params.query: whether the tasks visible before the reload are still visible in the todo list after the reload
action_params.code_js: (() => { const labels = Array.from(el(5).querySelectorAll('.todo-list li label')); return ['reload-persist-one','reload-persist-two','reload-persist-three'].every(t => labels.some(l => l.textContent.trim() === t && l.offsetParent !== null)); })()

assertion_tree.description: Each task visible immediately before the page reload remains visible immediately after the reload.

sub_results.description: Each task visible immediately before the page reload remains visible immediately after the reload.

assertion_tree.verification: the current page state shows that each task visible immediately before the page reload remains visible immediately after the reload
